name: SOPs and Guides Index
body:
> Index · 2026-10-22

Agency-wide standards, setup guides and handoffs that apply across all TAG clients.

# Content standards
- [SEO Blog Writing Standards](lib:brain-seo-blog-writing-standards): keyphrase, structure, linking and 10-point pre-delivery checklist for every client blog (Jun 12 2026).
- [GBP Content Batches](lib:brain-gbp-content-batches): July 2026 monthly and August GBP post batches for all four clients, merged across versions.

# Setup guides and SOPs
- [Claude Code Setup Guide](lib:brain-claude-code-setup-guide): installing and running Claude Code on Windows 11 with Git Bash (May 2026).
- [Google Ads MCP Setup SOP](lib:brain-google-ads-mcp-setup-sop): connecting the TAG MCC to Claude Code via the official read-only MCP (May 26 2026).
- [Google Ads Setup Session Notes 2026-05-26](lib:brain-google-ads-setup-session-notes-2026-05-26): decisions, identifiers and first live data pull from the setup session.
- [Instant Indexing Setup](lib:brain-instant-indexing-setup): service account plus Rank Math Instant Indexing plugin for Alphalete and Summit (Jun 11 2026).
- [SearchFit SEO Skills Guide](lib:brain-searchfit-seo-skills-guide): what the 17 SearchFit plugin skills do and cautions for TAG use (Sep 30 2026).

# Handoffs and logs
- [Session Handoff 2026-10-01 (All Clients)](lib:brain-session-handoff-2026-10-01-all-clients): agency-wide decisions, tool status, pending tasks and recurring workflows.
- [Organization Log 2026-10-01](lib:brain-organization-log-2026-10-01): old-to-new paths from the Oct 1 folder cleanup.

# Learning takeaways (stored in 30 Learning)
- [Lesson Takeaways 2026-10-08](lib:brain-lesson-takeaways-2026-10-08), [Lesson Takeaways 2026-10-09](lib:brain-lesson-takeaways-2026-10-09); see [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index).
